div.p: A mainly residential suburb in Melbourne's west, situated north of Deer Park between Station Road and the Kororoit Creek, Albanvale flourished from the 1970s. The suburb features the Brimbank Shopping Centre, and its major overseas-born groups include Vietnamese, Maltese, Filipinos, and people from the countries of the former Yugoslavia.
